column1: # 10202 (Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens) is a confirmed false positive here:
# ZAP's passive scanner only recognizes CSRF protection as a hidden token
# #preferences-form are method="dialog" forms - they never submit over
# HTTP at all; <dialog> forms only close the dialog. The actual submission
# goes through web/src/app.ts's api.request(), which attaches the real
# CSRF token as an x-csrf-token header on every non-GET/HEAD fetch (see
# is exercised by src/web/security/security.test.ts - a hidden input on a
# form that never POSTs would be decorative, not a real second control.
